subject: bug in labs() -- correct labeling requires "colour" not "color"

messages.author: 56148d40b6509fff
messages.subject: bug in labs() -- correct labeling requires "colour" not "color"
parts:
I came across this problem with labs() recently. I don't need a
workaround -- I just want to get this problem into the queue for a
future bug fix.

My sessionInfo() is listed at the bottom in case it's helpful.

thanks,

Dave
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

require(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)
d = expand.grid(group=1:2, tx = rep(1:4, 2))
d = transform(d, y = tx + rnorm(16))

qplot(tx, y, data=d, color=factor(group), main='Using "+
labs(colour=...)"') +
labs(colour='Study site')

qplot(tx, y, data=d, color=factor(group), main='Using "+
labs(color=...)"') +
labs(color='Study site')

# same problem, using ggplot instead of qplot
ggplot(d, aes(x=tx, y=y, color=factor(group))) +
geom_point() +
labs(colour='Study site')

ggplot(d, aes(x=tx, y=y, color=factor(group))) +
geom_point() +
labs(color='Study site')
